trustedSources.resolveOptOutToken: the opt-out link's own row: kernel.suppression_links matched on the sha256 of the 32-byte random token the link carries, which only the send path writes for that org and recipient (mail/commercial-footer.ts); the page acts for that org and that address fingerprint alone

reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/modules/mail/commercial-sen: the record of a commercial send after the provider accepted it: the org of the CommercialSend its two callers build themselves, the mail bridge from its own context org (commercialSendOf, kept in the bridge and never handed to the sandbox) and the composer send from the session org of the person sending (mail/service.ts); it writes one audit row and marks the notice for that org and that recipient only
reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/modules/mail/commercial-foo: marks the notice on the contacts of one recipient in the org it is given, inside recordCommercialSend's transaction for the org of its CommercialSend (the bridge's context org or the composer's session org); nothing of another org is read or written
reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/modules/contacts/prospect-r: the daily retention sweep: each org id comes from its own system read of the orgs that hold professional-interest contacts or an unread retention item (orgs being moved left out), and each org's row is refreshed in its own privileged transaction for that org only
stage-time check of a gated company call: requester is the staging actor, its org from that actor's own context; it reads only that org's companies and answers existence, nothing else
reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/modules/agent/runtime/tool-: no product caller (tests only): the hourly projects sweep clears cards with clearToolCardsByKeyIn inside its own per-org write. Given an org, it opens a privileged transaction for that org and matches every message row it reads and writes on that org (messages.org_id = orgId) and, when given, that thread, so it clears only that org's cards of that one key
reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/modules/apps/org-features.t: no product caller yet (the settings door that switches a feature will call it with the org of the admin's session, tests only today): writes only the (orgId, app, feature) row it is given

reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/apps/org-features.t: no product caller yet (the settings door that switches a feature will call it with the org of the admin's session, tests only today); what it hands on is the org id it was given, for that one org's cache and broadcast
reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/seed/tiers/demo/replace-dem: an operator's `liaison seed --tier lively --replace` or `seed --tier demo --variant visitor --reset` on a private box (refused in demo mode): the org under the slug the operator named is purged only when its row carries the demo marker, re-read fresh before the purge and again by purgeOrg's assertAllowed before every destructive step
reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/approvals/routed-re: sweep: pending approval rows a day old; each org's rows are reminded in that org
reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/apps/mail/summarizers.ts#su: approval summarizer registered by name: the approval pipeline calls it inside the approval's org
reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/modules/demo/worlds/saas/pa: the payments stand-in's event delivery: the org is either the one whose own sandbox call the stand-in just answered (provider.ts maybeDemoPaymentsResponse, past loadDemoOrg finding its demo marker, through standInDeps and scheduleDemoPaymentsEvent) or the visitor demo org a world beat runs for (payment-recovered.ts injectWorldEvent, ctx.orgId from runWorldBeatOnce); the bridge it builds runs inside withRlsContext for that same org

the stand-in's QA write, mounted only when LIAISON_DEMO_PAYMENTS_FIXTURES is set (app.ts): the body's org id is read only after verifyHarnessContext accepts the box's harness signature, loadDemoOrg reads its demo marker, and nothing is written unless the org carries it
